public class AdminEventCommentsActivity extends androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity implements EventCommentAdapter.OnCommentClickListener
Admin activity for viewing and moderating event comments in real-time. Uses Firestore snapshot listeners for automatic updates. Features: - Real-time comment updates (no manual refresh needed) - Delete comments with violation reasons - Track policy violations - Manual refresh option User stories supported: - US 03.10.01: Remove event comments that violate app policy
Version:
2.2 - Enhanced Debug + Delete UI
